Recall that 

- ${x}_{max}$ is the maximum of a set $S$ if ${x}_{max}\in S$ and $x\le {x}_{max}$ for all $x\in S,$ and

- ${x}_{min}$ is the minimum of a set $S$ if ${x}_{min}\in S$ and ${x}_{min}\le x$ for all $x\in S.$

Recall that $\pi =3.141….$ Therefore, we have the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}min(A) & =min\{1,\,\pi ,\,3,\,-2\}=-2 \\ max(A) & =max\{1,\,\pi ,\,3,\,-2\}=\pi \end{aligned}
$$
